verdict.rationale: The docs show HelixDB running outside Helix Cloud: a quickstart starts and stops a local instance, an embedded mode runs the same engine in process, and the same HTTP API is served by a local server and the Cloud gateway. The project is billed as Apache 2.0 open source, and `helix chef` scaffolds a local instance with no Cloud login. One community comment says the GitHub repo looks client-only, and another asks whether self-hosting is possible; these are questions rather than demonstrated failures, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: production self-hosted deployment and operations docs, confirmation that the full engine source is published, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.
